name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.8 degrees north of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 11 times in 5 visits over 20 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 22 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 20 hours starting 2026-06-22, at wavelengths from 1.31 to 4.86 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
